business_problem: Radisson needed to reach travelers earlier in AI-driven trip planning and create a direct booking path inside conversational discovery surfaces instead of waiting for guests to arrive through traditional hotel search channels.
solution_summary: Radisson Hotel Group partnered with Accenture Song and OpenAI to build a ChatGPT plugin that brings branded hotel discovery directly into travel-planning conversations. The plugin lets users see hotel suggestions on a map, compare pricing, inspect amenities, and continue to Radisson’s own booking flow without leaving the conversational context. Accenture and Radisson used agentic development to deliver the experience in six weeks, then extended the same infrastructure into sponsored advertising inside ChatGPT so organic discovery and paid promotion reinforce one another. Under the hood, the team created MCP server and API infrastructure that supports both the plugin and the ads experience, and that can power additional features over time. The result is a new direct digital front door for hotel shopping that treats ChatGPT as a planning surface where travelers shortlist options before ever reaching a hotel website.

data_flow: Traveler trip-planning prompts enter ChatGPT, where the Radisson plugin pulls hotel maps, prices, and amenity data through APIs and the MCP server. Users compare options conversationally, then continue into Radisson’s direct booking experience while sponsored ads reinforce visibility during planning.
business_outcome: Radisson improved conversion from conversational discovery, launched a new direct-booking surface quickly, and created a reusable infrastructure for future AI-driven travel-discovery features.

More than 1,640 hotels in operation and under development
